textures: Per-asset measured in each entry; new assets use flat shared PBR colors, two reused Standards retain embedded 1024px atlas.
source: Original kit meshes reused for Standard SedaPrep and ThermaNest; all other modules newly built. No original overwritten.

assets.name: BedsideCabinet_advanced
assets.collision_suggestion: Use simple box/compound-box collider around solid body; do not collide anchors. Curtain fabric can be trigger-only.
assets.interaction_suggestion: Use named ANCHOR nodes for editor placements; no behavior or clinical simulation is supplied.
assets.source: New modular geometry based on approved v2 sheet.
assets.runtime_organization: Static geometry consolidated by material. Drawer fronts with nearby pulls and cabinet doors retained as named separate mesh nodes; work anchors retained. Editable source scene keeps fine-grained components.
